1.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'هُوَ'?

example.english: Say: He is Allah, the One

2.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'هُمْ'?

example.english: And they — in the Hereafter — are the losers

3.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَنْتَ'?

example.english: Indeed You are the Knowing, the Wise

4.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَنْتُمْ'?

example.english: And you will be superior if you are believers

5.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَنَا'?

example.arabic: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا
example.english: Indeed I am Allah; there is no deity except Me

6.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَحْنُ'?

example.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ
example.english: Indeed it is We who sent down the remembrance and We will preserve it

7.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'هِيَ'?

example.english: Indeed that is the great attainment

8.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'هُنَّ'?

example.arabic: هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ
example.english: They are garments for you and you are garments for them

9.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَنْتِ'?

example.english: And you are free of restriction in this city

10.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَنْتُنَّ'?

example.arabic: لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِّنَ النِّسَاءِ إِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ
example.english: You are not like any other women if you fear Allah

11.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'هُمَا'?

example.english: So they both ate from it and their shame appeared to them

12.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَنْتُمَا'?

example.english: Go both of you to Pharaoh; indeed he has transgressed

13.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'هذا'?

example.english: This is a notification for the people that they may be warned

14.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ذَلِكَ'?

example.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
example.english: That is the Book about which there is no doubt, guidance for the righteous

15.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'هذه'?

example.arabic: هَٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ
example.english: This is the Hellfire which the criminals denied

16.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'تِلْكَ'?

example.arabic: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ
example.english: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth

17.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'هؤلاء'?

example.arabic: هَٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمُنَا اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً
example.english: These — our people — have taken deities besides Him

18.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أولئك'?

example.english: Those are upon guidance from their Lord

19.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'الَّذِي'?

example.english: Who created you and proportioned you and assembled you

20.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'الَّتِي'?

example.english: The fire whose fuel is people and stones

21.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'الَّذِينَ'?

example.english: Those who believe in the unseen and establish prayer

22.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رَبّ'?

example.english: All praise is for Allah, Lord of all worlds

23.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رَحْمٰن'?

example.english: The Most Merciful rose above the Throne

24.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رَحِيم'?

example.english: And Allah is Ever Forgiving, Merciful

25.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَزِيز'?

example.english: Indeed Allah is Mighty, Wise

26.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَكِيم'?

example.english: And He is the Knowing, the Wise

27.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'غَفُور'?

example.english: Indeed Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

28.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قَدِير'?

example.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
example.english: Indeed Allah has power over all things

29.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'سَمِيع'?

example.english: Indeed He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing

30.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'بَصِير'?

example.english: And Allah is All-Seeing of what they do

31.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'تَوَّاب'?

example.english: Indeed He is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

32.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَلِيم'?

example.english: And Allah is Self-Sufficient, Forbearing

33.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'خَبِير'?

example.english: Indeed Allah is Aware of what you do

34.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَلِيم'?

example.english: And Allah is Knowing of all things

35.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قَرِيب'?

example.arabic: إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
example.english: Indeed Allah's mercy is near to those who do good

36.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كَبِير'?

example.english: And He is the Most High, the Grand

37.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَظِيم'?

example.english: And He is the Most High, the Most Great

38.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَفِيظ'?

example.english: And Allah is over all things a Guardian

39.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'شَكُور'?

example.english: Indeed Allah is Appreciative, All-Knowing

40.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَصِير'?

example.arabic: وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ نَصِيرًا
example.english: Sufficient is Allah as protector and sufficient is Allah as helper

41.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'وَكِيل'?
options: One who takes care of a thing
41.correct_answer: One who takes care of a thing

example.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
example.english: Put your trust in Allah; sufficient is Allah as Trustee

42.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَمِيد'?

example.english: Indeed Allah is Free of need, Praiseworthy

43.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَشَدّ'?

example.english: Allah is more severe in might and more severe in punishment

44.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَعْلَم'?

example.english: And Allah is most knowing of the wrongdoers

45.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَكْبَر'?

example.arabic: وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ
example.english: The remembrance of Allah is greater — and Allah knows what you do

46.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَحْسَن'?

example.arabic: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ دِينًا مِّمَّنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلَّهِ
example.english: Who is better in religion than one who submits his face to Allah

47.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَظْلَم'?

example.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ
example.english: Who is more unjust than one who prevents the mosques of Allah from being used

48.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَقْرَب'?

example.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
example.english: And We are nearer to him than you but you do not see

49.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'آية'?

example.english: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers

50.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'بَيِّنَة'?

example.arabic: حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ رَسُولٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ
example.english: Until there came to them clear evidence — a Messenger from Allah

51.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَنْعَام'?

example.english: And the cattle He created for you — in them is warmth

52.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'جَبَل'?

example.english: And at the mountains — how they were erected

53.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'بَحْر'?

example.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا
example.english: And it is He who subjected the sea so you may eat fresh fish from it

54.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'شَمْس'?

example.english: And the sun runs on its fixed course

55.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قَمَر'?

example.english: And for the moon We have determined phases

56.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'لَيْل'?

example.english: By the night when it covers

57.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَهَار'?

example.english: And the day when it displays it

58.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَرْض'?

example.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
example.english: To Allah belongs what is in the heavens and in the earth

59.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'سَمَاء'?

example.english: Have We not made the sky a protected ceiling

60.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رِيح'?

example.english: And We sent the winds as fertilizers

61.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'الآخِرَة'?

example.english: And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah

62.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قِيَامَة'?

example.arabic: وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا
example.english: And that the Hour is coming — there is no doubt about it

63.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ساعة'?

example.arabic: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا
example.english: Indeed the Hour is coming — there is no doubt in it

64.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'يَوْم'?
options: One who takes care of a thing

example.english: Master of the Day of Recompense

65.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'جَنَّة'?

example.english: Indeed the righteous will be in gardens and bliss

66.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'جَهَنَّم'?

example.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا لِّلطَّاغِينَ مَآبًا
example.english: Indeed Hell has been lying in wait as a return for the transgressors

67.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نار'?

example.english: And fear the Fire prepared for the disbelievers

68.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَذَاب'?

example.english: And for them is a painful punishment

69.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ثَوَاب'?

example.english: And with Allah is the best reward

70.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أجر'?

example.arabic: وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
example.english: And Allah does not allow the reward of good-doers to be lost

71.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'مَصِير'?

example.english: And to Allah is the final destination

72.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَبَدًا'?

example.arabic: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
example.english: Abiding therein forever — that is the great attainment

73.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'دين'?

example.english: Indeed the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam

74.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَقّ'?

example.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ
example.english: That is because Allah is the Truth and He gives life to the dead

75.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'باطل'?

example.english: And say: Truth has come and falsehood has departed

76.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نُور'?

example.english: Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth

77.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ظُلُمَات'?

example.english: He brings them out from darkness into light

78.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كتاب'?

example.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
example.english: That is the Book — no doubt about it — guidance for the righteous

79.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قران'?

example.arabic: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ
example.english: The month of Ramadan in which the Quran was revealed

80.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حِكْمَة'?

example.arabic: يُؤْتِي الْحِكْمَةَ مَن يَشَاءُ وَمَن يُؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا
example.english: He gives wisdom to whom He wills; whoever receives wisdom has received great good

81.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'صلوة'?

example.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَّوْقُوتًا
example.english: Indeed prayer is an obligation on believers at set times

82.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'إله'?

example.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
example.english: There is no deity except Him, the Compassionate, the Merciful

83.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'مَلَكَ'?

example.english: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth

84.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَرْش'?

example.english: Lord of the Magnificent Throne

85.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'غَيْب'?

example.english: Knower of the unseen and witnessed, the Grand, the Most High

86.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'شَهَادَة'?

example.english: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted

87.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَعْمَال'?

example.english: Their deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter

88.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حسَنَة'?

example.arabic: مَن جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا
example.english: Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times its like

89.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'سَيِّئَة'?

example.english: The recompense of an evil deed is an evil deed like it

90.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'خَيْر'?

example.arabic: وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ يَعْلَمْهُ اللَّهُ
example.english: And whatever good you do, Allah knows it

91.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'شر'?

example.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
example.english: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it

92.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'إِثْم'?

example.english: And do not cooperate in sin and aggression

93.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ذَنْب'?

example.english: And who forgives sins except Allah

94.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حرام'?

example.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا الزِّنَا إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَاحِشَةً وَسَاءَ سَبِيلًا
example.english: And do not approach immorality — it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way

95.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'فَضْل'?

example.english: And Allah is the possessor of great bounty

96.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نِعْمَة'?

example.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا
example.english: And if you count Allah's favors you could not enumerate them

97.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ماء'?

example.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ
example.english: And We made from water every living thing

98.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ملك'?

example.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ مَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَاءُ
example.english: Say: O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty — You give sovereignty to whom You will

99.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أُمّ'?

example.arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ
example.english: We enjoined man to be dutiful to his parents — his mother carried him in weakness

100.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أب'?

example.english: And when Abraham said to his father Azar

101.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'زوج'?

example.arabic: وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً
example.english: And created from it its mate and dispersed many men and women from them

102.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رَجُل'?

example.arabic: وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِّنْ أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ
example.english: And a man came running from the far end of the city

103.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'امْرَأَة'?

example.arabic: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ
example.english: Allah presents the example of the wife of Pharaoh for the believers

104.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'وَلَد'?

example.english: He neither begets nor is He born

105.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ابن'?

example.arabic: مَا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ
example.english: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men

106.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أخ'?

example.arabic: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ
example.english: The believers are but brothers so make peace between your brothers

107.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'وجه'?

example.english: So wherever you turn — there is the face of Allah

108.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَيْن'?

example.english: And be patient for the judgment of your Lord for you are under Our eyes

109.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'بَصَر'?

example.arabic: لَا تُدْرِكُهُ الْأَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْأَبْصَارَ
example.english: Vision perceives Him not but He perceives all vision

110.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَفْوَاه'?

example.arabic: يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ
example.english: They say with their mouths what is not in their hearts

111.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'لِسَان'?

example.arabic: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ
example.english: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the diversity of your languages

112.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قَلب'?

example.english: Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest

113.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'صَدْر'?

example.english: Did We not expand for you your breast

114.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'يد'?

example.english: The hand of Allah is over their hands

115.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رجل'?

example.arabic: وَاضْرِبْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
example.english: And strike with your foot — this is a cool spring to wash in and a drink

116.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَفْس'?

example.english: No soul is burdened beyond its capacity

117.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'روح'?

example.arabic: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي
example.english: They ask you about the spirit; say: the spirit is from the command of my Lord

118.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قوة'?

example.arabic: وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُم مَّا اسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍ
example.english: And prepare against them whatever you are able of strength

119.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'فَعَلَ'?

example.arabic: وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ
example.english: And whatever good you do — indeed Allah is Knowing of it

120.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'فَتَحَ'?

example.english: Indeed We have granted you a clear victory

121.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'بَعَثَ'?

example.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
example.english: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron

122.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'جَعَلَ'?

example.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ
example.english: And We made from water every living thing

123.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'جَمَعَ'?

example.arabic: يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ
example.english: He will gather you for the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt

124.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ذَهَبَ'?

example.arabic: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
example.english: If He wills He could take you away and bring a new creation

125.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رَفَعَ'?

example.english: And He raised some of them in degrees

126.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'سَحَرَ'?

example.english: They said: You are only of those who have been bewitched

127.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'صَلَحَ'?

example.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ مِن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ
example.english: Whoever does righteous deeds whether male or female

128.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'لَعَنَ'?

example.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ الْكَافِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا
example.english: Indeed Allah has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze

129.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'مَنَعَ'?

example.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ
example.english: What prevented people from believing when guidance came to them

130.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَفَعَ'?

example.arabic: لَا يَنفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِن قَبْلُ
example.english: No soul's belief will benefit it if it had not believed before

131.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَصَرَ'?

example.arabic: إِن يَنصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ
example.english: If Allah helps you — none can overcome you

132.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'بلَغَ'?

example.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَاسْتَوَىٰ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا
example.english: When he reached maturity and became full grown We gave him wisdom and knowledge

133.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'تَرَكَ'?

example.english: And He left them in darkness — not seeing

134.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَشَرَ'?

example.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا
example.english: The day We will gather them all — then say to those who associated partners

135.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَكَمَ'?

example.english: And Allah judges — there is no adjuster of His judgment

136.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'خَرَجَ'?

example.english: So he came out to his people from the sanctuary

137.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'خَلَدَ'?

example.english: He thinks his wealth will make him live forever

138.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'خَلَقَ'?

example.arabic: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ الظُّلُمَاتِ وَالنُّورَ
example.english: He created the heavens and earth and made the darkness and light

139.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'دَخَلَ'?

example.english: Enter it in peace, secure

140.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ذَكَرَ'?

example.english: So remember Allah often that you may succeed

141.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رَزَقَ'?

example.english: And He will provide for him from where he does not expect

142.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'سَجَدَ'?

example.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
example.english: To Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and earth

143.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'شَعَرَ'?

example.english: And they do not perceive when they will be resurrected

144.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'شَكَرَ'?

example.arabic: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
example.english: If you are grateful I will increase you; if you deny — My punishment is severe

145.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'صَدَقَ'?

example.english: And who is more truthful than Allah in statement

146.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَبَدَ'?

example.english: You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help

147.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'فَسَقَ'?

example.english: And He misleads by it only the defiantly disobedient

148.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قَتَلَ'?

example.arabic: مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا
example.english: Whoever kills a soul without right — it is as if he killed all mankind

149.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قَعَدَ'?

example.english: Not equal are those believers who sit at home

150.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كَتَبَ'?

example.english: Allah has written: I will surely overcome — I and My messengers

151.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كَتَمَ'?

example.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَا أَنزَلْنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ
example.english: Indeed those who conceal what We sent down of clear evidence

152.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كَفَرَ'?

example.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ
example.english: Indeed those who disbelieve — it is the same whether you warn them or not

153.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'مَكَرَ'?

example.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ
example.english: They plotted and Allah plotted — and Allah is the best of plotters

154.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَظَرَ'?

example.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
example.english: Do they not look at the camels — how they are created

155.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَفَخَ'?

example.arabic: وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ
example.english: And He breathed into him of His spirit and made for you hearing and sight

156.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ضَرَبَ'?

example.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ
example.english: We have set forth every kind of example in this Quran for people

157.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَمَلَ'?

example.english: We carried them on land and sea and provided for them

158.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'سَبَقَ'?

example.arabic: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ
example.english: They do not precede Him in speech and they act by His command

159.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رَجَعَ'?

example.english: Indeed to Allah we belong and to Him we return

160.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'صَبَرَ'?

example.english: And be patient; indeed Allah is with the patient

161.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ظَلَمَ'?

example.english: And your Lord does not wrong anyone

162.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَرَفَ'?

example.english: They recognize him just as they recognize their own sons

163.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَقَلَ'?

example.english: Do you not reason

164.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'غَفَرَ'?

example.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا
example.english: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and remove our evil deeds

165.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'قَدَرَ'?

example.english: And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal

166.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كَذَبَ'?

example.arabic: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِي الْكَذِبَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
example.english: Falsehood is only invented by those who do not believe

167.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كَسَبَ'?

example.arabic: لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ
example.english: For it is what it has earned and against it what it has incurred

168.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'مَلَكَ'?

example.english: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth

169.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'سَمِعَ'?

example.arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا
example.english: Allah has heard the words of the woman who argues with you about her husband

170.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَزِنَ'?

example.english: Do not grieve — indeed Allah is with us

171.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَسَبَ'?

example.english: Does man think he will be left unattended

172.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَفِظَ'?

example.english: They guard him by the command of Allah

173.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'خَسِرَ'?
options: One who takes care of a thing

example.arabic: قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ
example.english: Those who denied the meeting with Allah have truly lost

174.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'رَحِمَ'?

example.english: And He is ever Merciful to the believers

175.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'شَهِدَ'?

example.arabic: شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
example.english: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him

176.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَلِمَ'?

example.arabic: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
example.english: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal

177.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَمِلَ'?

example.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
example.english: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

178.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'فَقِهَ'?

example.english: But you do not understand their glorification

179.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'فَرِحَ'?

example.arabic: لَا تَفْرَحْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْفَرِحِينَ
example.english: Do not exult — indeed Allah does not like the exultant

180.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كَرِهَ'?

example.english: Allah disliked their setting out so He kept them back

181.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'لَبِثَ'?

example.english: How many years did you remain on earth

182.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'لَا'?

example.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
example.english: There is no deity except Allah alone — no partner for Him

183.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'إِلَّا'?
options: One who takes care of a thing

example.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
example.english: I did not create jinn and mankind except to worship Me

184.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'كَلا'?

example.english: Nay! Indeed man transgresses

185.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'لَنْ'?

example.arabic: لَن تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ
example.english: You will never attain righteousness until you spend of what you love

186.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'لَمْ'?

example.english: He neither begot nor was He born

187.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'بلى'?

example.arabic: بَلَىٰ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَأَحَاطَتْ بِهِ خَطِيئَتُهُ
example.english: Yes — whoever earns evil and his sin surrounds him

188.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'غَيْر'?

example.english: Not of those who have earned anger nor of those who are astray

189.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'دون'?

example.arabic: أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ
example.english: Do you worship besides Allah that which does not benefit you

190.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'نَعَمْ'?

example.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ
example.english: The day the horn is blown — whoever is in the heavens will be terrified

191.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَلَا'?

example.arabic: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ
example.english: Unquestionably — the allies of Allah — no fear will there be on them

192.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'فِي'?

example.arabic: وَلَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
example.english: And to Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is in the earth

193.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'عَنْ'?

example.english: And He pardons much

194.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ك'?

example.arabic: لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ
example.english: There is nothing like Him — and He is the Hearing, the Seeing

195.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ل'?

example.arabic: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
example.english: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth

196.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'مِنْ'?

example.arabic: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَندَادًا
example.english: And among people are those who take rivals to Allah

197.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'إلى'?

example.english: And to Allah all matters are returned

198.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'ب'?

example.english: In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful

199.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'حَتَّى'?

example.arabic: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ
example.english: Eat and drink until the white thread becomes distinct to you at dawn

200.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'على'?

example.arabic: وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ
example.english: And He is the Subjugator over His servants and He is the Wise, the Aware

201.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'مع'?

example.english: Indeed Allah is with those who fear Him

202.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'يَا'?

example.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ
example.english: O you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared

example.english: Whoever emigrates in the cause of Allah will find many places of refuge

434.question: What is the meaning of the word: 'أَسْلَمَ'?
